vnyan.send.description: Starts every "API Message" node in VNyan with this action name.

parameters.action: The name typed into the API Message node. Capital letters matter.
parameters.payload: Optional. An object of values for the node; numbers stay numbers and text stays text. name=value lines also work.

vnyan.sendWebSocket.description: Runs VNyan's "WebSocket" nodes with this command (Start Receiver must be on in VNyan).

parameters.value: Optional. A number sent after the command; the node gives it on as Value.

vnyan.setParameter.description: Sets a VNyan parameter over OSC (VNyan's OSC port must be set on the VNyan card).
